edition_title.en: SChannel gains native mTLS while server startup races are closed
edition_title.fr: SChannel gagne le mTLS natif et les courses au démarrage serveur sont éliminées
edition_title.zh: SChannel 获得原生 mTLS，服务器启动竞态得到修复
edition_title.ru: SChannel получает нативный mTLS, а гонки запуска серверов устранены

intro.en: Windows servers can now require and validate client certificates through SChannel, using the existing TNetTlsContext trust stores and verification callbacks. A second sequence repairs HTTP and async server construction so their main threads do not run before sockets, workers and cross-references are ready. Teams using Windows mTLS or constructing servers under load should land on the final build, not an intermediate commit in either sequence.
intro.fr: Les serveurs Windows peuvent désormais exiger et valider les certificats clients avec SChannel, via les stores de confiance et callbacks existants de TNetTlsContext. Une seconde série corrige la construction des serveurs HTTP et async afin que leurs threads principaux ne démarrent pas avant les sockets, workers et références croisées. Les équipes utilisant le mTLS Windows ou créant des serveurs sous charge doivent viser la build finale.
intro.zh: Windows 服务器现在可通过 SChannel 要求并验证客户端证书，并复用 TNetTlsContext 现有的信任存储与验证回调。另一组修改修复 HTTP 和 async 服务器构造顺序，避免主线程在 socket、worker 与交叉引用就绪前运行。使用 Windows mTLS 或在高负载下创建服务器的团队应直接采用最终 build。
intro.ru: Windows-серверы теперь могут требовать и проверять клиентские сертификаты через SChannel, используя существующие trust stores и callbacks TNetTlsContext. Вторая серия исправляет создание HTTP и async servers: главные потоки не запускаются до готовности sockets, workers и перекрёстных ссылок. Командам с Windows mTLS или созданием серверов под нагрузкой следует брать финальную build.

en: SChannel servers now implement mTLS through ClientCertificateAuthentication, CACertificatesFile, CASystemStores, CACertificatesRaw, OnEachPeerVerify and OnAfterPeerValidate.
HTTP and async server threads now stay suspended until their sockets, workers and owner links are initialized.
Upgrade for the CACertificatesRaw loading fix, explicit missing-client-certificate errors and final SChannel declaration/cache corrections.
Public additions include acoCreateSuspended, ConsoleLock/ConsoleUnLock and WinCryptTextToBinary.
fr: Visez la build 2.4.17294 au commit de8d47ea7122b30aa81296a1e5e899a3909e34b1.
Les serveurs SChannel implémentent le mTLS via ClientCertificateAuthentication, CACertificatesFile, CASystemStores, CACertificatesRaw, OnEachPeerVerify et OnAfterPeerValidate.
Les threads des serveurs HTTP et async restent suspendus jusqu’à l’initialisation des sockets, workers et liens d’ownership.
Mettez à niveau pour le chargement de CACertificatesRaw, les erreurs explicites de certificat client absent et les corrections finales SChannel.
Les ajouts publics comprennent acoCreateSuspended, ConsoleLock/ConsoleUnLock et WinCryptTextToBinary.
zh: SChannel 服务器现通过 ClientCertificateAuthentication、CACertificatesFile、CASystemStores、CACertificatesRaw、OnEachPeerVerify 与 OnAfterPeerValidate 实现 mTLS。
HTTP 与 async 服务器线程会保持 suspended，直到 socket、worker 与 owner link 完成初始化。
应升级以获得 CACertificatesRaw 加载修复、缺少客户端证书的明确错误及最终 SChannel 声明与 cache 修正。
新增公开 API 包括 acoCreateSuspended、ConsoleLock/ConsoleUnLock 与 WinCryptTextToBinary。
ru: SChannel servers реализуют mTLS через ClientCertificateAuthentication, CACertificatesFile, CASystemStores, CACertificatesRaw, OnEachPeerVerify и OnAfterPeerValidate.
Потоки HTTP и async servers остаются suspended до инициализации sockets, workers и owner links.
Обновитесь ради исправления CACertificatesRaw, явной ошибки отсутствующего client certificate и финальных правок SChannel declarations/cache.
В public API добавлены acoCreateSuspended, ConsoleLock/ConsoleUnLock и WinCryptTextToBinary.

title.fr: SChannel gagne le mTLS natif côté serveur
title.zh: SChannel 获得原生服务端 mTLS

summary.en: Windows servers can request client certificates, build chains from system or in-memory CA sources, enforce client-auth EKU and run both per-certificate and final peer callbacks.
summary.fr: Les serveurs Windows peuvent demander un certificat client, construire la chaîne depuis les stores système ou des CA en mémoire, vérifier l’EKU client-auth et appeler les deux niveaux de callback.
summary.zh: Windows 服务器可请求客户端证书，从系统或内存 CA 构建证书链，检查 client-auth EKU，并运行逐证书与最终 peer callback。
summary.ru: Windows servers могут запрашивать client certificate, строить chain из system или in-memory CA, проверять client-auth EKU и вызывать оба уровня callbacks.

title.fr: La construction serveur devient explicitement biphasée
title.zh: 服务器构造改为明确的两阶段流程

summary.en: TLoggedThread, TAsyncConnections, THttpAsyncServer and THttpServerGeneric coordinate suspended construction and AfterConstruction startup so background execution sees fully published state.
summary.fr: TLoggedThread, TAsyncConnections, THttpAsyncServer et THttpServerGeneric coordonnent construction suspendue et démarrage dans AfterConstruction afin que l’exécution voie un état complet.
summary.zh: TLoggedThread、TAsyncConnections、THttpAsyncServer 与 THttpServerGeneric 协调 suspended 构造和 AfterConstruction 启动，使后台执行只看到完整状态。
summary.ru: TLoggedThread, TAsyncConnections, THttpAsyncServer и THttpServerGeneric согласуют suspended construction и запуск в AfterConstruction, чтобы фон видел полностью опубликованное состояние.

title.en: TLS tests cover the new server paths in parallel
title.fr: Les tests TLS couvrent les nouveaux chemins serveur en parallèle
title.zh: TLS 测试并行覆盖新的服务器路径
title.ru: TLS-тесты параллельно покрывают новые server paths

summary.en: The network suite exercises SChannel and OpenSSL servers, client-certificate acceptance and rejection, callback context and parallel startup without changing application code.
summary.fr: La suite réseau exerce les serveurs SChannel et OpenSSL, l’acceptation et le rejet des certificats clients, le contexte des callbacks et le démarrage parallèle sans changer le code applicatif.
summary.zh: 网络测试覆盖 SChannel 与 OpenSSL 服务器、客户端证书接受/拒绝、callback context 与并行启动，不改变应用代码。
summary.ru: Network suite проверяет SChannel/OpenSSL servers, принятие и отклонение client certificates, callback context и параллельный запуск без изменения application code.

order.why: Take the SChannel chain declarations, mTLS implementation, classic-server propagation, CA loading and final Windows compatibility fixes together.
Take the entire suspended-construction sequence; the last commit corrects the preceding startup changes.
Take the console lock API with its TSynTests integration.

upgrade_advice.en: Land on build 2.4.17294. Upgrade promptly if a Windows server uses or plans client-certificate authentication, if CACertificatesRaw supplies trust anchors, or if HTTP/async servers are created and started under concurrency. Verify accepted and rejected client chains, OnEachPeerVerify overrides, OnAfterPeerValidate context and both classic THttpServer and THttpAsyncServer startup. The raw payload has no superseded_by markers, so no formal avoid range is asserted; take the complete ordered sequences instead of cherry-picking their intermediate commits.
upgrade_advice.fr: Visez la build 2.4.17294. Mettez à niveau si un serveur Windows utilise l’authentification par certificat client, si CACertificatesRaw fournit les ancres de confiance, ou si des serveurs HTTP/async sont créés sous concurrence. Vérifiez les chaînes acceptées/refusées, les overrides OnEachPeerVerify, le contexte OnAfterPeerValidate et le démarrage de THttpServer comme THttpAsyncServer. Aucun superseded_by n’étaye une plage formelle à éviter ; prenez les séries complètes.
upgrade_advice.zh: 请采用 build 2.4.17294。若 Windows 服务器使用或准备使用客户端证书认证、由 CACertificatesRaw 提供信任锚，或在并发环境中创建 HTTP/async 服务器，应尽快升级。请测试证书链接受与拒绝、OnEachPeerVerify override、OnAfterPeerValidate context，以及 THttpServer 与 THttpAsyncServer 启动。原始 payload 没有 superseded_by，因此不声明正式避开区间；请完整采用有序序列，不要挑选其中间 commit。
upgrade_advice.ru: Переходите на build 2.4.17294. Срочно обновитесь, если Windows server использует client-certificate authentication, CACertificatesRaw задаёт trust anchors или HTTP/async servers создаются конкурентно. Проверьте accepted/rejected chains, overrides OnEachPeerVerify, context OnAfterPeerValidate и запуск THttpServer/THttpAsyncServer. В raw payload нет superseded_by, поэтому формальный avoid range не заявляется; берите полные последовательности, не отдельные промежуточные commits.

notes.en: Reviewed all 26 non-merge commits from build 2.4.17269 through 2.4.17294: 1,474 additions and 440 deletions after excluding mormot.commit.inc and mormot.commit-num.inc. The exact upstream head was inspected. No commit carries superseded_by metadata; upgrade ordering follows directly inspected same-unit follow-ups without asserting an avoid range.
notes.fr: Les 26 commits non-merge de 2.4.17269 à 2.4.17294 ont été examinés : 1 474 ajouts et 440 suppressions hors mormot.commit.inc et mormot.commit-num.inc. Le head upstream exact a été inspecté. Aucun superseded_by ; l’ordre vient des follow-ups des mêmes units sans plage à éviter.
notes.zh: 已审查 build 2.4.17269 至 2.4.17294 的全部 26 个 non-merge commit：排除 mormot.commit.inc 与 mormot.commit-num.inc 后新增 1,474 行、删除 440 行。已检查精确 upstream head。没有 superseded_by；升级顺序来自同 unit follow-up，不声明避开区间。
notes.ru: Проверены все 26 non-merge commits от 2.4.17269 до 2.4.17294: 1 474 добавления и 440 удалений без mormot.commit.inc и mormot.commit-num.inc. Проверен точный upstream head. superseded_by отсутствует; порядок основан на follow-ups тех же units без avoid range.

headline.en: The Lazarus aggregate package now includes Windows cryptography
headline.fr: Le package agrégé Lazarus inclut désormais la cryptographie Windows
headline.zh: Lazarus 聚合 package 现在包含 Windows 密码学 unit
headline.ru: Агрегирующий Lazarus package теперь включает Windows cryptography

what_changed.en: packages/lazarus/mormot2.pas adds mormot.crypt.win to its uses list so the aggregate FPC package compiles and registers the Windows cryptography unit introduced earlier.
what_changed.fr: packages/lazarus/mormot2.pas ajoute mormot.crypt.win à ses uses afin que le package FPC agrégé compile et enregistre la nouvelle unit cryptographique Windows.
what_changed.zh: packages/lazarus/mormot2.pas 在 uses 中加入 mormot.crypt.win，使聚合 FPC package 能编译并注册此前新增的 Windows 密码学 unit。
what_changed.ru: packages/lazarus/mormot2.pas добавляет mormot.crypt.win в uses, чтобы агрегирующий FPC package компилировал и регистрировал новую Windows cryptography unit.

impact.en: Lazarus package users no longer miss mormot.crypt.win symbols. Delphi projects and FPC projects listing units directly are unchanged.
impact.fr: Les utilisateurs du package Lazarus ne perdent plus les symboles de mormot.crypt.win. Les projets Delphi et les projets FPC listant les units directement ne changent pas.
impact.zh: Lazarus package 用户不再缺少 mormot.crypt.win 符号；Delphi 项目和直接列出 unit 的 FPC 项目不受影响。
impact.ru: Пользователи Lazarus package больше не теряют symbols mormot.crypt.win. Delphi и FPC проекты с прямым списком units не меняются.

headline.en: Final SChannel fixes avoid type conflicts and blocking chain retrieval
headline.fr: Les dernières corrections SChannel évitent les conflits de types et les téléchargements bloquants
headline.zh: 最终 SChannel 修复避免类型冲突与阻塞式证书链获取
headline.ru: Финальные исправления SChannel устраняют конфликт типов и блокирующую загрузку chain

what_changed.en: mormot.net.sock.windows uses its own certificate-context pointer declarations, sets SCH_CRED_CACHE_ONLY_URL_RETRIEVAL_ON_CREATE, and finalizes SChannel test and Windows-version guards. This avoids Delphi RTL PCCERT_CONTEXT conflicts and network URL retrieval during credential creation.
what_changed.fr: mormot.net.sock.windows utilise ses propres pointeurs de contexte certificat, active SCH_CRED_CACHE_ONLY_URL_RETRIEVAL_ON_CREATE et finalise les guards de version Windows. Cela évite le conflit PCCERT_CONTEXT du RTL Delphi et les téléchargements réseau pendant la création des credentials.
what_changed.zh: mormot.net.sock.windows 使用自身的证书 context 指针声明，设置 SCH_CRED_CACHE_ONLY_URL_RETRIEVAL_ON_CREATE，并完善 SChannel 测试与 Windows 版本 guard，避免 Delphi RTL PCCERT_CONTEXT 冲突及创建 credential 时的网络 URL 获取。
what_changed.ru: mormot.net.sock.windows использует собственные указатели certificate context, задаёт SCH_CRED_CACHE_ONLY_URL_RETRIEVAL_ON_CREATE и завершает guards версий Windows, устраняя конфликт PCCERT_CONTEXT в Delphi RTL и сетевую URL retrieval при создании credentials.

impact.en: Windows Delphi and FPC builds get a stable final mTLS path, and server startup no longer blocks on certificate-chain URL fetching. Non-Windows TLS backends are unaffected.
impact.fr: Les builds Windows Delphi et FPC obtiennent un chemin mTLS final stable, sans blocage au démarrage pour récupérer une chaîne par URL. Les backends non-Windows ne changent pas.
impact.zh: Windows Delphi 与 FPC 构建获得稳定的最终 mTLS 路径，服务器启动不再因通过 URL 获取证书链而阻塞；非 Windows TLS backend 不受影响。
impact.ru: Windows builds Delphi/FPC получают стабильный финальный mTLS path, а startup не блокируется на URL fetching цепочки. Не-Windows TLS backends не затронуты.

action_detail.en: Take build 2.4.17294 and retest Windows client-certificate validation without outbound chain URLs.
action_detail.fr: Prenez la build 2.4.17294 et retestez la validation des certificats clients Windows sans URL de chaîne sortante.
action_detail.zh: 采用 build 2.4.17294，并在无外部证书链 URL 的条件下重测 Windows 客户端证书验证。
action_detail.ru: Берите build 2.4.17294 и проверьте Windows client-certificate validation без внешних chain URLs.

headline.en: Server threads now start only after construction completes
headline.fr: Les threads serveur ne démarrent qu’après la fin de la construction
headline.zh: 服务器线程现在只在构造完成后启动
headline.ru: Потоки серверов запускаются только после завершения construction

what_changed.en: TLoggedThread.AfterConstruction now calls inherited before Start. THttpServerGeneric and TAsyncConnections always create their RTL thread suspended, remember the caller's suspended option, and start only after construction; THttpAsyncServer also marks esRunning only after its bound socket is valid.
what_changed.fr: TLoggedThread.AfterConstruction appelle inherited avant Start. THttpServerGeneric et TAsyncConnections créent toujours leur thread RTL suspendu, mémorisent l’option demandée et ne démarrent qu’après construction ; THttpAsyncServer passe à esRunning après validation du socket lié.
what_changed.zh: TLoggedThread.AfterConstruction 现在先调用 inherited 再 Start。THttpServerGeneric 与 TAsyncConnections 总是以 suspended 创建 RTL thread，保存调用方选项并在构造后启动；THttpAsyncServer 也仅在 bound socket 有效后设置 esRunning。
what_changed.ru: TLoggedThread.AfterConstruction вызывает inherited перед Start. THttpServerGeneric и TAsyncConnections всегда создают RTL thread suspended, запоминают опцию и запускают после construction; THttpAsyncServer ставит esRunning только после проверки bound socket.

impact.en: HTTP and async servers no longer race their constructors or report running before binding succeeds. This affects Delphi and FPC backends on every platform using these server classes.
impact.fr: Les serveurs HTTP et async ne courent plus contre leurs constructeurs et ne signalent plus running avant un bind réussi. Tous les backends Delphi/FPC utilisant ces classes sont concernés.
impact.zh: HTTP 与 async 服务器不再与自身 constructor 竞争，也不会在 bind 成功前报告 running；所有使用这些服务器类的 Delphi/FPC backend 均受益。
impact.ru: HTTP и async servers больше не гонятся с constructors и не сообщают running до успешного bind. Исправление касается Delphi/FPC backends на всех платформах с этими классами.

action_detail.en: Land on 2.4.17294 and stress repeated create/start/free cycles for THttpServer, THttpAsyncServer and custom TAsyncConnections descendants.
action_detail.fr: Visez 2.4.17294 et stressez les cycles create/start/free de THttpServer, THttpAsyncServer et des descendants TAsyncConnections.
action_detail.zh: 采用 2.4.17294，并压力测试 THttpServer、THttpAsyncServer 与自定义 TAsyncConnections 子类的反复 create/start/free。
action_detail.ru: Берите 2.4.17294 и нагрузочно проверьте циклы create/start/free для THttpServer, THttpAsyncServer и наследников TAsyncConnections.

headline.en: HTTP server families adopt deferred main-thread startup
headline.fr: Les familles de serveurs HTTP adoptent un démarrage différé
headline.zh: HTTP 服务器家族采用延迟主线程启动
headline.ru: Семейства HTTP servers переходят на отложенный запуск главного потока

what_changed.en: TAsyncConnections and THttpServerGeneric set TLoggedThread.fStartAfterConstruction from their public suspended options, while THttpApiServer drops a manual Start because the base class now owns startup timing.
what_changed.fr: TAsyncConnections et THttpServerGeneric définissent TLoggedThread.fStartAfterConstruction depuis leurs options publiques de suspension, tandis que THttpApiServer supprime son Start manuel car la classe de base gère le timing.
what_changed.zh: TAsyncConnections 与 THttpServerGeneric 根据公开 suspended 选项设置 TLoggedThread.fStartAfterConstruction；THttpApiServer 删除手动 Start，由基类管理启动时机。
what_changed.ru: TAsyncConnections и THttpServerGeneric задают TLoggedThread.fStartAfterConstruction из public suspended options, а THttpApiServer удаляет ручной Start, поскольку timing теперь контролирует base class.

impact.en: This is an intermediate startup repair later corrected by 0b8d9252. Do not cherry-pick it without the final construction changes.
impact.fr: Il s’agit d’une correction intermédiaire ensuite ajustée par 0b8d9252. Ne la cherry-pickez pas sans la fin de la série.
impact.zh: 这是启动修复的中间步骤，随后由 0b8d9252 修正；不要脱离最终构造修改单独 cherry-pick。
impact.ru: Это промежуточная startup-правка, позднее исправленная 0b8d9252. Не cherry-pick без финальных изменений construction.

headline.en: TLoggedThread gains an internal post-construction start switch
headline.fr: TLoggedThread reçoit un déclencheur interne après construction
headline.zh: TLoggedThread 新增构造后启动的内部开关
headline.ru: TLoggedThread получил внутренний переключатель запуска после construction

what_changed.en: mormot.core.threads adds the protected fStartAfterConstruction flag and an AfterConstruction override so descendants can defer leaving the suspended state until object construction has finished.
what_changed.fr: mormot.core.threads ajoute le flag protégé fStartAfterConstruction et override AfterConstruction afin que les descendants restent suspendus jusqu’à la fin de leur construction.
what_changed.zh: mormot.core.threads 新增 protected 的 fStartAfterConstruction 与 AfterConstruction override，使子类可在对象构造完成前保持 suspended。
what_changed.ru: mormot.core.threads добавляет protected flag fStartAfterConstruction и override AfterConstruction, позволяя наследникам оставаться suspended до завершения object construction.

impact.en: This internal mechanism supports the server startup repair. Existing application threads are unchanged unless a custom descendant opts into the protected flag.
impact.fr: Ce mécanisme interne soutient la correction du démarrage serveur. Les threads applicatifs existants ne changent pas sauf si un descendant active le flag protégé.
impact.zh: 该内部机制支撑服务器启动修复；现有应用线程不受影响，除非自定义子类主动设置该 protected flag。
impact.ru: Внутренний механизм поддерживает server startup fix. Существующие application threads не меняются, если custom descendant не использует protected flag.

headline.en: Async HTTP initialization publishes state before execution
headline.fr: L’initialisation HTTP async publie son état avant l’exécution
headline.zh: Async HTTP 初始化先发布状态再执行
headline.ru: Async HTTP initialization публикует состояние до выполнения

what_changed.en: mormot.net.async and mormot.net.ws.async move accept-only flags, bound-socket publication, owner links and WebSocket keep-instance setup earlier in construction, before worker and main-loop execution can observe them.
what_changed.fr: mormot.net.async et mormot.net.ws.async avancent les flags accept-only, la publication du socket, les liens d’owner et l’initialisation WebSocket keep-instance avant toute exécution des workers et de la boucle principale.
what_changed.zh: mormot.net.async 与 mormot.net.ws.async 将 accept-only flag、bound socket 发布、owner link 和 WebSocket keep-instance 初始化提前，使 worker 与主循环执行前即可看到它们。
what_changed.ru: mormot.net.async и mormot.net.ws.async переносят accept-only flags, публикацию bound socket, owner links и WebSocket keep-instance setup до выполнения workers и main loop.

impact.en: The async stack sees consistent constructor state, reducing startup races. It is part of the same sequence finalized by 0b8d9252 and needs no application migration.
impact.fr: La pile async voit un état cohérent du constructeur, réduisant les races. Cette étape est finalisée par 0b8d9252 et ne demande aucune migration.
impact.zh: Async stack 能看到一致的 constructor 状态，降低启动竞态；该步骤由 0b8d9252 完成，不需要应用迁移。
impact.ru: Async stack видит согласованное constructor state, уменьшая startup races. Серия завершена 0b8d9252 и не требует migration.

headline.en: THttpAsyncServer links its threads before either can run
headline.fr: THttpAsyncServer relie ses threads avant leur exécution
headline.zh: THttpAsyncServer 在任一线程运行前完成关联
headline.ru: THttpAsyncServer связывает потоки до запуска любого из них

what_changed.en: THttpAsyncServer.Create builds both the inherited server thread and fAsync suspended, assigns reciprocal references, then starts the async side and waits for socket binding instead of exposing partially linked objects.
what_changed.fr: THttpAsyncServer.Create construit le thread hérité et fAsync suspendus, affecte les références réciproques, puis démarre le côté async et attend le bind du socket.
what_changed.zh: THttpAsyncServer.Create 以 suspended 状态构造继承的服务器线程与 fAsync，设置双向引用后再启动 async 侧并等待 socket bind，避免暴露未完整关联的对象。
what_changed.ru: THttpAsyncServer.Create создаёт inherited server thread и fAsync suspended, задаёт взаимные ссылки, затем запускает async side и ждёт socket bind.

impact.en: This removes a constructor window where either thread could dereference missing owner state. It is an intermediate fix completed by the later startup commits.
impact.fr: Cela supprime une fenêtre où un thread pouvait déréférencer un owner absent. C’est une étape intermédiaire complétée ensuite.
impact.zh: 修复任一线程在 constructor 窗口解引用缺失 owner 状态的问题；这是随后启动提交完成的中间修复。
impact.ru: Устраняется окно constructor, где поток мог обратиться к отсутствующему owner state. Это промежуточный fix, завершённый позднее.

headline.en: TAsyncConnections can be constructed with its main loop suspended
headline.fr: TAsyncConnections peut être construit avec sa boucle principale suspendue
headline.zh: TAsyncConnections 可在主循环 suspended 状态下构造
headline.ru: TAsyncConnections может создаваться с suspended main loop

what_changed.en: The public acoCreateSuspended option is added to TAsyncConnectionsOptions. TAsyncConnections.Create uses it to keep the main thread suspended until workers and initialization are ready.
what_changed.fr: L’option publique acoCreateSuspended est ajoutée à TAsyncConnectionsOptions. TAsyncConnections.Create l’utilise pour suspendre le thread principal jusqu’à ce que workers et initialisation soient prêts.
what_changed.zh: TAsyncConnectionsOptions 新增公开选项 acoCreateSuspended；TAsyncConnections.Create 用它让主线程保持 suspended，直到 worker 与初始化就绪。
what_changed.ru: В TAsyncConnectionsOptions добавлена public option acoCreateSuspended. TAsyncConnections.Create удерживает main thread suspended до готовности workers и initialization.

impact.en: Custom async-server descendants can explicitly control initial execution. Existing option sets keep their prior default, while framework constructors use the option internally for safe startup.
impact.fr: Les descendants async personnalisés peuvent contrôler le démarrage. Les sets existants gardent leur défaut et le framework utilise l’option pour un startup sûr.
impact.zh: 自定义 async server 子类可显式控制初始执行；现有 option set 保持原默认值，framework 内部使用该选项保障安全启动。
impact.ru: Custom async-server descendants могут управлять initial execution. Существующие option sets сохраняют default, framework использует опцию для безопасного startup.

headline.en: SChannel integration tests cover the completed client-auth matrix
headline.fr: Les tests SChannel couvrent la matrice complète d’authentification client
headline.zh: SChannel 集成测试覆盖完整客户端认证矩阵
headline.ru: Интеграционные тесты SChannel покрывают полную матрицу client auth

what_changed.en: TNetworkProtocols._SChannel extends the final Windows TLS matrix across server implementations, certificate-authority inputs and client-certificate outcomes after the mTLS changes.
what_changed.fr: TNetworkProtocols._SChannel étend la matrice TLS Windows finale sur les implémentations serveur, les sources de CA et les résultats de certificats clients.
what_changed.zh: TNetworkProtocols._SChannel 在 mTLS 修改后扩展最终 Windows TLS 矩阵，覆盖不同服务器实现、CA 输入与客户端证书结果。
what_changed.ru: TNetworkProtocols._SChannel расширяет финальную Windows TLS matrix по server implementations, источникам CA и результатам client certificates.

impact.en: Regression coverage increases; Delphi/FPC application code and runtime behavior are unchanged by this test-only commit.
impact.fr: La couverture de régression augmente ; le code applicatif et le runtime Delphi/FPC ne changent pas.
impact.zh: 回归覆盖增加；此纯测试提交不改变 Delphi/FPC 应用代码与运行时行为。
impact.ru: Regression coverage растёт; application code и runtime Delphi/FPC не меняются.

headline.en: OpenSSL server tests exercise more TLS validation paths
headline.fr: Les tests serveur OpenSSL exercent davantage de validations TLS
headline.zh: OpenSSL 服务器测试覆盖更多 TLS 验证路径
headline.ru: Тесты OpenSSL server покрывают больше TLS validation paths

what_changed.en: test.net.proto expands OpenSSL TLS server coverage alongside the new shared peer-validation callback behavior and the SChannel client-certificate cases.
what_changed.fr: test.net.proto étend la couverture des serveurs TLS OpenSSL avec le comportement partagé du callback de validation et les cas SChannel de certificat client.
what_changed.zh: test.net.proto 扩展 OpenSSL TLS 服务器覆盖，并验证新的共享 peer-validation callback 行为及 SChannel 客户端证书场景。
what_changed.ru: test.net.proto расширяет покрытие OpenSSL TLS server вместе с общим peer-validation callback и SChannel client-certificate cases.

impact.en: This is test-only coverage. It gives maintainers parity checks between OpenSSL and SChannel without changing public APIs.
impact.fr: C’est uniquement de la couverture de tests, avec des contrôles de parité OpenSSL/SChannel sans changement d’API publique.
impact.zh: 这是纯测试覆盖，为 OpenSSL 与 SChannel 提供一致性检查，不改变公开 API。
impact.ru: Это test-only coverage для parity checks OpenSSL/SChannel без изменений public API.

headline.en: SChannel test servers now run concurrently
headline.fr: Les serveurs de test SChannel tournent désormais en parallèle
headline.zh: SChannel 测试服务器现在并行运行
headline.ru: Тестовые SChannel servers теперь работают параллельно

what_changed.en: The network test suite starts multiple SChannel server variants in parallel, exercising concurrent console output and independent TLS server lifetimes.
what_changed.fr: La suite réseau démarre plusieurs variantes de serveurs SChannel en parallèle, exerçant la sortie console concurrente et des cycles de vie TLS indépendants.
what_changed.zh: 网络测试套件并行启动多个 SChannel 服务器变体，覆盖并发 console 输出与独立 TLS 服务器生命周期。
what_changed.ru: Network test suite запускает несколько вариантов SChannel server параллельно, проверяя concurrent console output и независимые TLS lifetimes.

impact.en: Only the test harness changes. Production Delphi/FPC backends gain no direct behavioral or API change.
impact.fr: Seul le harnais de test change ; aucun comportement ni API de production n’est modifié.
impact.zh: 仅测试 harness 发生变化；生产 Delphi/FPC backend 没有直接行为或 API 变化。
impact.ru: Меняется только test harness; production backends не получают behavioral или API changes.

headline.en: TSynTests serializes multi-threaded console updates
headline.fr: TSynTests sérialise les mises à jour console multithread
headline.zh: TSynTests 串行化多线程 console 更新
headline.ru: TSynTests сериализует multithread console updates

what_changed.en: mormot.core.test wraps TSynTests progress, color and error-output sequences with ConsoleLock and ConsoleUnLock so parallel suites cannot interleave cursor and color state.
what_changed.fr: mormot.core.test entoure les séquences de progression, couleur et erreurs de TSynTests avec ConsoleLock et ConsoleUnLock afin que les suites parallèles ne mélangent pas l’état du curseur et des couleurs.
what_changed.zh: mormot.core.test 用 ConsoleLock 与 ConsoleUnLock 包围 TSynTests 的进度、颜色和错误输出序列，防止并行测试混合 cursor 与颜色状态。
what_changed.ru: mormot.core.test оборачивает progress, color и error output TSynTests в ConsoleLock/ConsoleUnLock, чтобы параллельные suites не смешивали cursor и color state.

impact.en: Parallel test output remains readable. Application backends are unaffected unless they use TSynTests as part of their own tooling.
impact.fr: La sortie des tests parallèles reste lisible. Les backends applicatifs ne sont pas concernés sauf usage direct de TSynTests.
impact.zh: 并行测试输出保持可读；应用 backend 不受影响，除非自身工具直接使用 TSynTests。
impact.ru: Вывод параллельных тестов остаётся читаемым. Application backends не затронуты, кроме прямого использования TSynTests.

headline.en: Public console locking supports atomic output sequences
headline.fr: Un verrouillage console public protège les séquences de sortie atomiques
headline.zh: 公开 console 锁支持原子输出序列
headline.ru: Public console locking поддерживает атомарные output sequences

what_changed.en: mormot.core.os adds ConsoleLock and ConsoleUnLock wrappers over the reentrant ConsoleCriticalSection, allowing callers to protect a multi-call console update as one sequence.
what_changed.fr: mormot.core.os ajoute ConsoleLock et ConsoleUnLock au-dessus du ConsoleCriticalSection réentrant afin de protéger une mise à jour console multi-appels comme une seule séquence.
what_changed.zh: mormot.core.os 在可重入 ConsoleCriticalSection 之上新增 ConsoleLock 与 ConsoleUnLock，使调用方可将多次 console 更新作为一个序列保护。
what_changed.ru: mormot.core.os добавляет ConsoleLock и ConsoleUnLock поверх reentrant ConsoleCriticalSection, позволяя защищать многошаговый console update как одну последовательность.

impact.en: Tools and test runners can prevent interleaved output across threads. Existing console calls retain their behavior.
impact.fr: Les outils et tests peuvent empêcher l’entrelacement des sorties entre threads. Les appels console existants gardent leur comportement.
impact.zh: 工具和测试 runner 可防止跨线程输出交错；现有 console 调用行为不变。
impact.ru: Tools и test runners могут исключить interleaved output между потоками. Существующие console calls не меняются.

headline.en: In-memory CA certificates now reach SChannel validation
headline.fr: Les certificats CA en mémoire atteignent désormais la validation SChannel
headline.zh: 内存 CA 证书现在正确进入 SChannel 验证
headline.ru: In-memory CA certificates теперь попадают в SChannel validation

what_changed.en: TSChannelServerContext.Create fixes an else binding in the trust-source selection so CACertificatesRaw entries are parsed and added when neither CACertificatesFile nor CASystemStores supplies the CA set.
what_changed.fr: TSChannelServerContext.Create corrige l’association d’un else dans le choix des sources de confiance, afin que CACertificatesRaw soit analysé et ajouté quand aucun fichier ni store système ne fournit les CA.
what_changed.zh: TSChannelServerContext.Create 修正信任源选择中的 else 绑定，使 CACertificatesFile 与 CASystemStores 均未提供 CA 时，CACertificatesRaw 条目能够被解析并加入。
what_changed.ru: TSChannelServerContext.Create исправляет привязку else при выборе trust source, чтобы CACertificatesRaw разбирался и добавлялся, когда CA не заданы файлом или system stores.

impact.en: Windows mTLS servers that pass PEM roots through CACertificatesRaw now validate against those roots instead of silently omitting them.
impact.fr: Les serveurs mTLS Windows passant leurs roots PEM via CACertificatesRaw valident désormais contre ces roots au lieu de les ignorer silencieusement.
impact.zh: 通过 CACertificatesRaw 传入 PEM root 的 Windows mTLS 服务器现在会使用这些 root 验证，不再静默忽略。
impact.ru: Windows mTLS servers с PEM roots в CACertificatesRaw теперь действительно проверяют по этим roots, а не молча пропускают их.

action_detail.en: Upgrade and test both a trusted and an untrusted client chain when CACertificatesRaw is the only CA source.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau et testez une chaîne cliente valide et invalide lorsque CACertificatesRaw est la seule source de CA.
action_detail.zh: 升级后，在 CACertificatesRaw 为唯一 CA 来源时分别测试受信与不受信客户端证书链。
action_detail.ru: Обновитесь и проверьте trusted и untrusted client chain, когда CACertificatesRaw — единственный CA source.

headline.en: SChannel tests add trust and callback edge cases
headline.fr: Les tests SChannel ajoutent des cas limites de confiance et callbacks
headline.zh: SChannel 测试新增信任与 callback 边界场景
headline.ru: Тесты SChannel добавляют edge cases trust и callbacks

what_changed.en: test.net.proto broadens SChannel coverage around CA sources, peer callbacks and client-certificate outcomes while the implementation is being completed.
what_changed.fr: test.net.proto élargit la couverture SChannel autour des sources CA, callbacks peer et résultats de certificat client pendant la finalisation de l’implémentation.
what_changed.zh: test.net.proto 在实现完善期间扩展 SChannel 覆盖，包含 CA 来源、peer callback 与客户端证书结果。
what_changed.ru: test.net.proto расширяет SChannel coverage для CA sources, peer callbacks и client-certificate outcomes во время завершения implementation.

impact.en: The change improves regression detection only; no application code or public API changes.
impact.fr: Le changement améliore uniquement la détection de régressions ; aucun code applicatif ni API publique ne change.
impact.zh: 该修改仅提高回归检测能力；应用代码与公开 API 不变。
impact.ru: Изменение улучшает только regression detection; application code и public API не меняются.

headline.en: SChannel reports missing client credentials and trust failures clearly
headline.fr: SChannel signale clairement les credentials clients absents et les échecs de confiance
headline.zh: SChannel 明确报告缺失客户端 credential 与信任失败
headline.ru: SChannel явно сообщает об отсутствии client credentials и trust failures

what_changed.en: The Windows TLS path recognizes SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS for absent client certificates, expands SSPI error text, and tightens chain-policy failure handling while preserving callback override behavior.
what_changed.fr: Le chemin TLS Windows reconnaît SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS pour un certificat client absent, enrichit les erreurs SSPI et resserre la gestion des échecs de chain policy tout en conservant les overrides de callback.
what_changed.zh: Windows TLS 路径对缺失客户端证书识别 SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS，扩展 SSPI 错误文本，并收紧 chain policy 失败处理，同时保留 callback override 行为。
what_changed.ru: Windows TLS path распознаёт SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS при отсутствии client certificate, расширяет SSPI error text и ужесточает chain-policy failures, сохраняя callback override.

impact.en: mTLS rejection is explicit and diagnosable instead of surfacing as an ambiguous handshake failure. Windows Delphi and FPC servers are affected; other backends are not.
impact.fr: Le rejet mTLS devient explicite et diagnosticable au lieu d’un échec de handshake ambigu. Les serveurs Windows Delphi/FPC sont concernés.
impact.zh: mTLS 拒绝变得明确且可诊断，不再表现为模糊 handshake 失败；影响 Windows Delphi/FPC 服务器，其他 backend 不受影响。
impact.ru: mTLS rejection становится явным и диагностируемым вместо неоднозначного handshake failure. Затронуты Windows servers Delphi/FPC.

action_detail.en: Verify logs and client-visible behavior for missing, expired and untrusted client certificates.
action_detail.fr: Vérifiez les logs et le comportement client pour les certificats absents, expirés et non fiables.
action_detail.zh: 验证客户端证书缺失、过期与不受信时的日志及客户端可见行为。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте logs и client-visible behavior для отсутствующих, expired и untrusted client certificates.

headline.en: The network suite gains an end-to-end SChannel mTLS server test
headline.fr: La suite réseau reçoit un test serveur mTLS SChannel de bout en bout
headline.zh: 网络测试套件新增端到端 SChannel mTLS 服务器测试
headline.ru: Network suite получил end-to-end тест SChannel mTLS server

what_changed.en: test.net.proto creates Windows SChannel servers with client-certificate authentication and exercises successful and failed handshakes against generated test identities.
what_changed.fr: test.net.proto crée des serveurs Windows SChannel avec authentification par certificat client et exerce les handshakes réussis et refusés avec des identités de test.
what_changed.zh: test.net.proto 创建启用客户端证书认证的 Windows SChannel 服务器，并用生成的测试 identity 覆盖成功与失败 handshake。
what_changed.ru: test.net.proto создаёт Windows SChannel servers с client-certificate authentication и проверяет успешные/ошибочные handshakes с тестовыми identities.

impact.en: This is regression coverage for the new feature and does not itself change application behavior.
impact.fr: Il s’agit de couverture de régression pour la nouvelle fonction, sans changement de comportement applicatif.
impact.zh: 这是新功能的回归覆盖，本身不改变应用行为。
impact.ru: Это regression coverage новой функции без самостоятельного изменения application behavior.

headline.en: SChannel mTLS gains Windows 7 compatibility and stricter chain checks
headline.fr: Le mTLS SChannel gagne la compatibilité Windows 7 et des contrôles de chaîne plus stricts
headline.zh: SChannel mTLS 增加 Windows 7 兼容与更严格证书链检查
headline.ru: SChannel mTLS получил совместимость с Windows 7 и более строгие chain checks

what_changed.en: mormot.net.sock.windows uses the shorter CERT_CHAIN_ENGINE_CONFIG layout supported by Windows 7, rejects older systems for mTLS, refines client-auth EKU and trust handling, and corrects chain-engine cleanup.
what_changed.fr: mormot.net.sock.windows utilise la structure CERT_CHAIN_ENGINE_CONFIG courte compatible Windows 7, refuse les systèmes plus anciens pour le mTLS, affine EKU/trust et corrige le nettoyage du chain engine.
what_changed.zh: mormot.net.sock.windows 使用 Windows 7 支持的较短 CERT_CHAIN_ENGINE_CONFIG 布局，在更旧系统上拒绝 mTLS，完善 client-auth EKU 与信任处理，并修正 chain engine 清理。
what_changed.ru: mormot.net.sock.windows использует короткий CERT_CHAIN_ENGINE_CONFIG для Windows 7, отклоняет mTLS на более старых системах, уточняет client-auth EKU/trust и исправляет cleanup chain engine.

impact.en: Windows 7 can use the new server mTLS path; pre-Windows-7 hosts receive a clear unsupported result. Chain resources are released correctly.
impact.fr: Windows 7 peut utiliser le nouveau mTLS serveur ; les systèmes plus anciens reçoivent un résultat unsupported clair. Les ressources de chaîne sont libérées correctement.
impact.zh: Windows 7 可使用新的服务端 mTLS；更旧系统会得到明确 unsupported 结果，证书链资源也能正确释放。
impact.ru: Windows 7 может использовать новый server mTLS; более старые системы получают явный unsupported result. Chain resources освобождаются корректно.

action_detail.en: Use the final edition head and include the oldest supported Windows version in mTLS tests.
action_detail.fr: Utilisez le head final et incluez la plus ancienne version Windows supportée dans les tests mTLS.
action_detail.zh: 使用本期最终 head，并在 mTLS 测试中加入最旧受支持 Windows 版本。
action_detail.ru: Используйте финальный head и включите самую старую поддерживаемую Windows в mTLS tests.

headline.en: Windows SChannel servers can require client certificates
headline.fr: Les serveurs Windows SChannel peuvent exiger un certificat client
headline.zh: Windows SChannel 服务器可要求客户端证书
headline.ru: Windows SChannel servers могут требовать client certificate

what_changed.en: TSChannelServerContext implements server-side mTLS from TNetTlsContext: it loads configured CA sources, builds an exclusive chain engine when needed, requests client credentials, checks client-auth EKU and runs OnEachPeerVerify and OnAfterPeerValidate.
what_changed.fr: TSChannelServerContext implémente le mTLS serveur depuis TNetTlsContext : chargement des CA, chain engine exclusif si nécessaire, demande de credentials clients, contrôle de l’EKU client-auth et appels OnEachPeerVerify/OnAfterPeerValidate.
what_changed.zh: TSChannelServerContext 基于 TNetTlsContext 实现服务端 mTLS：加载配置的 CA 来源，必要时构建独占 chain engine，请求客户端 credential，检查 client-auth EKU，并运行 OnEachPeerVerify 与 OnAfterPeerValidate。
what_changed.ru: TSChannelServerContext реализует server-side mTLS из TNetTlsContext: загружает CA sources, при необходимости создаёт exclusive chain engine, запрашивает client credentials, проверяет client-auth EKU и вызывает OnEachPeerVerify/OnAfterPeerValidate.

impact.en: Windows backends can use native SChannel for mutual TLS without switching to OpenSSL. Existing servers remain one-way TLS unless ClientCertificateAuthentication is enabled.
impact.fr: Les backends Windows peuvent utiliser SChannel natif pour le TLS mutuel sans passer à OpenSSL. Les serveurs existants restent en TLS unidirectionnel tant que ClientCertificateAuthentication est désactivé.
impact.zh: Windows backend 可直接用原生 SChannel 实现双向 TLS，无需切换 OpenSSL；现有服务器在未启用 ClientCertificateAuthentication 时仍为单向 TLS。
impact.ru: Windows backends могут использовать native SChannel для mutual TLS без OpenSSL. Существующие servers остаются one-way TLS, пока ClientCertificateAuthentication выключен.

action_detail.en: If adopting SChannel mTLS, configure one CA source and test the two verification callbacks against your certificate policy on 2.4.17294.
action_detail.fr: Pour adopter le mTLS SChannel, configurez une source CA et testez les deux callbacks avec votre policy sur 2.4.17294.
action_detail.zh: 若采用 SChannel mTLS，请配置一个 CA 来源，并在 2.4.17294 上按自身证书策略测试两个验证 callback。
action_detail.ru: При внедрении SChannel mTLS настройте один CA source и проверьте оба callbacks с вашей certificate policy на 2.4.17294.

headline.en: Windows trust failures receive readable error names
headline.fr: Les erreurs de confiance Windows reçoivent des noms lisibles
headline.zh: Windows 信任失败获得可读错误名称
headline.ru: Ошибки Windows trust получили читаемые имена

what_changed.en: mormot.core.os extends Windows error-code lookup with SChannel, SSPI and certificate-trust constants so diagnostics show symbolic names for chain and policy failures.
what_changed.fr: mormot.core.os étend la résolution des codes Windows avec les constantes SChannel, SSPI et certificate-trust afin d’afficher des noms symboliques pour les échecs de chaîne et de policy.
what_changed.zh: mormot.core.os 扩展 Windows 错误码解析，加入 SChannel、SSPI 与证书信任常量，使证书链和 policy 失败显示符号名称。
what_changed.ru: mormot.core.os расширяет lookup Windows error codes константами SChannel, SSPI и certificate trust, показывая symbolic names для chain/policy failures.

impact.en: Logs and exceptions are easier to diagnose. Runtime trust decisions and application APIs are unchanged.
impact.fr: Les logs et exceptions sont plus faciles à diagnostiquer. Les décisions de confiance et API restent inchangées.
impact.zh: 日志与异常更易诊断；运行时信任决策和应用 API 不变。
impact.ru: Logs и exceptions легче диагностировать. Trust decisions и application APIs не меняются.

headline.en: Classic HTTP servers preserve full TLS client-auth policy per connection
headline.fr: Les serveurs HTTP classiques conservent toute la policy client-auth par connexion
headline.zh: 经典 HTTP 服务器为每个连接保留完整 TLS 客户端认证策略
headline.ru: Классические HTTP servers сохраняют полную TLS client-auth policy на соединение

what_changed.en: THttpServerSocket.Create copies the complete TNetTlsContext into each accepted connection when client-certificate authentication is active, then resets transient state. OpenSSL validation also clears stale LastError and computes verification once.
what_changed.fr: THttpServerSocket.Create copie le TNetTlsContext complet dans chaque connexion acceptée lorsque l’authentification client est active, puis réinitialise l’état transitoire. La validation OpenSSL efface aussi LastError et ne calcule la vérification qu’une fois.
what_changed.zh: 启用客户端证书认证时，THttpServerSocket.Create 会把完整 TNetTlsContext 复制到每个已接受连接，再重置临时状态；OpenSSL 验证也会清除旧 LastError 并只计算一次结果。
what_changed.ru: THttpServerSocket.Create копирует полный TNetTlsContext в каждое accepted connection при client-certificate authentication, затем сбрасывает transient state. OpenSSL validation очищает LastError и вычисляет результат один раз.

impact.en: Threaded THttpServer connections now retain CA lists and verification callbacks needed for mTLS. OpenSSL callbacks no longer inherit a stale error from a prior verification.
impact.fr: Les connexions THttpServer threaded conservent les CA et callbacks nécessaires au mTLS. Les callbacks OpenSSL n’héritent plus d’une ancienne erreur.
impact.zh: Threaded THttpServer 连接现在会保留 mTLS 所需 CA 列表与验证 callback；OpenSSL callback 不再继承上一次验证的旧错误。
impact.ru: Threaded THttpServer connections сохраняют CA lists и callbacks для mTLS. OpenSSL callbacks больше не наследуют stale error предыдущей проверки.

action_detail.en: Retest mTLS through both THttpServer and THttpAsyncServer, including callback rejection and acceptance.
action_detail.fr: Retestez le mTLS via THttpServer et THttpAsyncServer, y compris le rejet et l’acceptation par callback.
action_detail.zh: 通过 THttpServer 与 THttpAsyncServer 重测 mTLS，包括 callback 拒绝与接受场景。
action_detail.ru: Перепроверьте mTLS через THttpServer и THttpAsyncServer, включая callback reject/accept.

headline.en: A JSON length guard is rewritten without changing its result
headline.fr: Un contrôle de longueur JSON est réécrit sans changer son résultat
headline.zh: JSON 长度 guard 被重写但结果不变
headline.ru: JSON length guard переписан без изменения результата

what_changed.en: TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer replaces one short-circuit condition with nested checks for MaxLen and Len. The final predicate remains MaxLen greater than zero and Len greater than MaxLen.
what_changed.fr: TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer remplace une condition short-circuit par deux contrôles imbriqués sur MaxLen et Len. Le prédicat final reste identique.
what_changed.zh: TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer 将一个 short-circuit 条件改写为对 MaxLen 与 Len 的嵌套检查；最终判断仍是 MaxLen 大于零且 Len 超过 MaxLen。
what_changed.ru: TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer заменяет short-circuit condition вложенными проверками MaxLen и Len; итоговый predicate остаётся тем же.

impact.en: No observable application behavior or public API changes; this is a control-flow rewrite of the guard fixed in the preceding edition.
impact.fr: Aucun comportement observable ni API publique ne change ; c’est une réécriture du guard corrigé dans l’édition précédente.
impact.zh: 应用可观察行为与公开 API 均不变；这是对上一期已修复 guard 的控制流改写。
impact.ru: Наблюдаемое application behavior и public API не меняются; это переписывание guard, исправленного в предыдущем выпуске.

headline.en: TLS callback and Windows decoding helpers are consolidated
headline.fr: Les helpers de callback TLS et de décodage Windows sont consolidés
headline.zh: TLS callback 与 Windows 解码 helper 被统一整理
headline.ru: TLS callback и Windows decoding helpers консолидированы

what_changed.en: mormot.lib.openssl11 moves final peer-callback assembly into a local helper, while mormot.lib.sspi reuses the shared WinCryptTextToBinary wrapper instead of a private CryptStringToBinaryA path.
what_changed.fr: mormot.lib.openssl11 regroupe l’assemblage du callback peer final dans un helper local, tandis que mormot.lib.sspi réutilise WinCryptTextToBinary au lieu d’un chemin privé CryptStringToBinaryA.
what_changed.zh: mormot.lib.openssl11 将最终 peer callback 参数组装移入局部 helper；mormot.lib.sspi 改用共享 WinCryptTextToBinary，不再走私有 CryptStringToBinaryA 路径。
what_changed.ru: mormot.lib.openssl11 переносит сборку final peer callback в local helper, а mormot.lib.sspi использует общий WinCryptTextToBinary вместо private CryptStringToBinaryA path.

impact.en: TLS verification behavior remains the same while duplicated conversion and callback code is removed. No application migration is required.
impact.fr: Le comportement de vérification TLS reste identique, avec moins de code dupliqué. Aucune migration applicative n’est nécessaire.
impact.zh: TLS 验证行为不变，同时删除重复转换与 callback 代码；无需应用迁移。
impact.ru: TLS verification behavior не меняется, duplicated conversion/callback code удалён. Migration не нужна.

headline.en: OpenSSL servers now invoke the final peer-validation callback
headline.fr: Les serveurs OpenSSL appellent désormais le callback final de validation peer
headline.zh: OpenSSL 服务器现在调用最终 peer 验证 callback
headline.ru: OpenSSL servers теперь вызывают final peer-validation callback

what_changed.en: TOpenSslNetTls.AfterAccept calls TNetTlsContext.OnAfterPeerValidate after a successful server handshake, providing the TLS context, peer certificate, cipher information and the current verification result.
what_changed.fr: TOpenSslNetTls.AfterAccept appelle TNetTlsContext.OnAfterPeerValidate après un handshake serveur réussi, avec le contexte TLS, le certificat peer, le cipher et le résultat de validation.
what_changed.zh: 服务器 handshake 成功后，TOpenSslNetTls.AfterAccept 会调用 TNetTlsContext.OnAfterPeerValidate，并提供 TLS context、peer certificate、cipher 信息与当前验证结果。
what_changed.ru: После успешного server handshake TOpenSslNetTls.AfterAccept вызывает TNetTlsContext.OnAfterPeerValidate, передавая TLS context, peer certificate, cipher и verification result.

impact.en: OpenSSL server users get callback parity with the new SChannel path. Existing callbacks may now run on server accepts where they previously did not.
impact.fr: Les utilisateurs OpenSSL obtiennent la parité avec SChannel. Les callbacks existants peuvent désormais s’exécuter lors des accept serveur.
impact.zh: OpenSSL 服务器获得与新 SChannel 路径一致的 callback；现有 callback 可能在此前不会触发的 server accept 上运行。
impact.ru: OpenSSL server users получают parity с SChannel. Существующие callbacks теперь могут вызываться на server accepts, где раньше не запускались.

action_detail.en: Review OnAfterPeerValidate handlers for server-side assumptions and test both accepted and rejected peer certificates.
action_detail.fr: Examinez les handlers OnAfterPeerValidate pour leurs hypothèses côté serveur et testez certificats acceptés et rejetés.
action_detail.zh: 审查 OnAfterPeerValidate handler 的服务端假设，并测试接受与拒绝 peer certificate。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте handlers OnAfterPeerValidate на server-side assumptions и протестируйте accepted/rejected peer certificates.

headline.en: A Windows wrapper decodes PEM and Base64 certificate text
headline.fr: Un wrapper Windows décode le texte certificat PEM et Base64
headline.zh: 新增 Windows wrapper 解码 PEM 与 Base64 证书文本
headline.ru: Windows wrapper декодирует PEM и Base64 certificate text

what_changed.en: mormot.core.os.security adds WinCryptTextToBinary, a public RawUtf8-to-RawByteString wrapper over CryptStringToBinaryA with CRYPT_STRING_BASE64HEADER as the default, and streamlines WinCryptBinaryAppendAsText.
what_changed.fr: mormot.core.os.security ajoute WinCryptTextToBinary, wrapper public RawUtf8 vers RawByteString autour de CryptStringToBinaryA avec CRYPT_STRING_BASE64HEADER par défaut, et optimise WinCryptBinaryAppendAsText.
what_changed.zh: mormot.core.os.security 新增公开 WinCryptTextToBinary，将 RawUtf8 通过 CryptStringToBinaryA 转为 RawByteString，默认使用 CRYPT_STRING_BASE64HEADER，并优化 WinCryptBinaryAppendAsText。
what_changed.ru: mormot.core.os.security добавляет public WinCryptTextToBinary, wrapper RawUtf8-to-RawByteString над CryptStringToBinaryA с default CRYPT_STRING_BASE64HEADER, и упрощает WinCryptBinaryAppendAsText.

impact.en: Windows code gains one checked helper for PEM/Base64 decoding. Existing callers are source-compatible and can opt in.
impact.fr: Le code Windows gagne un helper contrôlé pour décoder PEM/Base64. Les appelants existants restent compatibles et peuvent l’adopter.
impact.zh: Windows 代码获得统一的 PEM/Base64 解码 helper；现有调用保持源兼容，可选择采用。
impact.ru: Windows code получает checked helper для PEM/Base64 decoding. Существующие callers совместимы и могут перейти на него.

headline.en: SChannel declarations expose Windows certificate-chain engines
headline.fr: Les déclarations SChannel exposent les chain engines de certificats Windows
headline.zh: SChannel 声明公开 Windows 证书链 engine
headline.ru: Декларации SChannel предоставляют Windows certificate-chain engines

what_changed.en: mormot.lib.sspi adds the Windows certificate-chain structures, callbacks, constants and API imports required to create restricted chain engines and evaluate SSL chain policy for client certificates.
what_changed.fr: mormot.lib.sspi ajoute les structures, callbacks, constantes et imports Windows nécessaires pour créer des chain engines restreints et évaluer la policy SSL des certificats clients.
what_changed.zh: mormot.lib.sspi 新增 Windows 证书链结构、callback、常量与 API import，用于创建受限 chain engine 并评估客户端证书 SSL chain policy。
what_changed.ru: mormot.lib.sspi добавляет Windows certificate-chain structures, callbacks, constants и API imports для restricted chain engines и оценки SSL chain policy клиентских сертификатов.

impact.en: Low-level Windows Delphi/FPC code can call the chain APIs directly, and SChannel mTLS has the declarations it needs. Other platforms are unchanged.
impact.fr: Le code Windows Delphi/FPC bas niveau peut appeler directement les chain APIs et le mTLS SChannel dispose des déclarations nécessaires. Les autres plateformes ne changent pas.
impact.zh: 低层 Windows Delphi/FPC 代码可直接调用证书链 API，SChannel mTLS 也获得所需声明；其他平台不变。
impact.ru: Низкоуровневый Windows Delphi/FPC code может вызывать chain APIs напрямую, а SChannel mTLS получает нужные declarations. Другие платформы не меняются.
